subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit `/model` callback issue, or choose the open sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Both open candidates solve the same user-visible bug with different callback formats, and the provider/model routing contract should be intentional before merge.

options.title: Use This PR As Canonical
options.body: Land this minimal index-plus-identity fallback if maintainers prefer preserving existing name callbacks and only adding indexed callbacks for over-limit models.

options.title: Use The Sibling Candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 if maintainers prefer its broader indexed callback contract, then pause or close this PR.

options.title: Hold For Owner Selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the permanent callback format.

recommendation.title: Use This PR As Canonical
recommendation.body: Land this minimal index-plus-identity fallback if maintainers prefer preserving existing name callbacks and only adding indexed callbacks for over-limit models.

likelyOwner.reason: The callback byte-limit helper history makes this the best available routing owner for the callback-format decision.
